title: KPop Demon Hunters 3” Figure Anime Zoey K-pop Toy Doll Animation Figurine
descriptionText: The KPop Demon Hunters 3” Figure of Anime Zoey is a colorful PVC figurine of the popular character from the K-Pop Demon Hunters TV show. Standing at 4 inches tall, this action figure is a part of the Kpop Demon Hunters franchise and features intricate details that capture the essence of the character. Packaged in a box, this original figurine is a must-have collectible for fans of the show. Made in China in 2025, this anime-inspired toy brings the world of K-Pop Demon Hunters to life for collectors and enthusiasts alike.
